system_name: M5 structure -> M1 VLB sell / VHB buy + Engulf
ltf_confirm: VLB: Visual Low Break for sells — M1 BOS/CHoCH below a low, small pullback, then engulf to a new lower low
VHB: Visual High Break for buys — M1 CHoCH above a high, pullback (sometimes none), then engulf to a new higher high
risk: 0.5-1%; user-proposed XAUUSD $3 price distance or ATR, untested; ATR period/multiplier and choice unspecified; sell stop above entry/beyond VLB, buy stop below entry

m5_part1_user_description.source: User-supplied Part 1 description, not independently validated against the screenshots
confirmed_by_user: Use New York or Asian session as a golden-session requirement for future entries.
A bullish M5 BOS closes above the last swing high; a bearish M5 BOS closes below the last swing low.
Wait for a 0.382 retracement after BOS; the user has now provided Part 2 for M1 entries.

m1_part2_user_description.source: User-described Part 2; not fitted or independently verified against the journal
rules: At a 0.382 reaction, a bullish CHoCH breaks the visual lower high, and bearish CHoCH breaks the visual higher low.
Then wait for an opposite-colored pullback candle and larger opposite engulfing body; enter on engulf close.
Stop beyond engulfing candle with 10 ticks buffer; configurable R:R target.
needs_confirmation: Exact visual swing and reaction definitions and tolerance; two confirmed pivots are a provisional machine interpretation.
The bullish example calls the high break VHB but also mentions a VLB anchor. Confirm whether these are distinct levels before changing any journal label.
Session times/timezones and precise bearish fib anchors remain unconfirmed.
m1_part2_user_description.implementation: Separate default-off M5/M1 structural simulation, not fitted to journal or a live bridge.

m5_part3_user_description.source: User-provided Part 3; not fitted to the journal or verified on its screenshots
rules: Bearish M5 structure uses Heikin Ashi, with lower-low and lower-high structure and a break below the prior low.
The bearish 0.382 retracement is the newly formed lower low plus 0.382 times the difference from the previous higher low.
On M1, the explicit implementation describes a bearish CHoCH below a higher low followed by a larger bearish engulfing candle and a stop above its high.
needs_confirmation: Which actual prior pivot is the visual previous higher low; the script provisionally takes the earlier of two descending confirmed pivot lows.
Bearish narrative says break a lower high whereas the implementation says break a higher low; v14 follows the implementation.
Session windows, pivot definitions, and whether bullish M5 also uses HA remain unconfirmed.
m5_part3_user_description.implementation: Standalone default-off M5/M1 structural simulation; no live bridge, not fitted to journal.

m5_part4_user_description.source: User-provided Part 4, not fitted to the 40-record journal or validated on screenshots
rules: FTB is a failed M5 break with a closed Heikin Ashi candle shifting against the expected direction.
Failed high seeks bearish M1 CHoCH; failed low seeks bullish M1 CHoCH. FTB bypasses the BT 0.382 gate.
